=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15148-15163 (also get_issue_labels_json 4384-4387; call sites 27400-27432) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the labels read fails, get_issue_labels_json returns `[]`, so the `ai:comprehensive-test-pending` and `ai:integration-backpressure` checks in close_completed_tracking_issue_if_ready both pass and the tracking issue is closed with `.tracking_auto_close.outcome="closed"` recorded.
  WHY: On the same tick handle_comprehensive_release_callback_if_needed also sees no pending label and returns without handling the callback; once the issue is closed the poller no longer visits it, so the pending release callback is dropped for good, which is the failure condition 5 exists to prevent. All reviewers rated this MAJOR. Suggested fail-closed fix: defer with `reason=labels_unavailable` unless `ai:orchestrator-tracking` is present.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15196-15204 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: After a successful PATCH close, failures in the `.tracking_auto_close` STATE_FILE write and in `post_state_comment` are swallowed with `|| true`, and the function still logs `outcome=closed`.
  WHY: If the state is not persisted and someone reopens the issue, the next tick finds no `.tracking_auto_close.outcome`, sees the trusted `<!-- ai:tracking-auto-close:v1 ... -->` marker, takes the PATCH-retry path and silently re-closes the issue, which breaks the documented "reopen keeps it open" contract. Severity disagreement: sonnet, gemini, minimax and luna rated it MAJOR and glm rated it NIT, so the highest (MAJOR) is used.
- scripts/check_triage_resolution.py:511-547 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In _integration_evidence, `verdict["evidence_ref"] = f"integration_pr:{integration_number}"` and `verdict["integration_pr"] = integration_number` are set before the `integration_pr_cross_repository` and `integration_pr_closed` trust checks.
  WHY: Unverified results still report `evidence_ref=integration_pr:<n>` in the gate JSON and on the CHECK_TRIAGE_RESOLVED log line, naming a PR the gate just rejected; resolution itself is unaffected. All three reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1197-1232 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new activation_final_verdict_from_comments helper (1208-1230) was inserted between run_project_activation_verify's header comment (1197-1207) and that function's definition (1232).
  WHY: The documentation of an existing function now sits above a different function; behaviour is unaffected. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15104-15206 (call site line 27432) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: close_completed_tracking_issue_if_ready runs implicit writes (one comment POST, one PATCH, one state comment) on every poller tick for status=complete projects.
  WHY: The reviewer noted these writes are documented and gated by the ORCHESTRATOR_CLOSE_COMPLETED_TRACKING kill switch, the one-shot `.tracking_auto_close` guard and the trust filters, and that "It does not" fail at runtime (NIT).
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:10570, 12105 (PR-head changes at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1245 and 27432) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate reports test_complete_verdict_falls_through_to_finalize_on_integration_drift and test_sync_superseded_sets_state_once_and_skips_future_sync_attempts as failures caused by this change.
  WHY: The gate on the PR head blocks merge until the failures are reproduced and fixed, or shown to be inherited from the merge-base or sharding artifacts; the mechanism could not be derived statically (MAJOR).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:whole script (new code at 1208-1230, 15011-15027, 15074-15206, 27429-27432) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate lists shellcheck as a failure caused by this change, but static inspection could not reproduce the diagnostic.
  WHY: The shellcheck gate stays red on the PR head until the diagnostic is fixed or shown to be a gate-run artifact (MAJOR).
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1414-1415, 1605-1606 | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate also attributes failures in tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py (5 cases), tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py, tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_session_start_extract_repo_slug.py and tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py to this change, although the diff touches none of their subjects.
  WHY: If these failures are real, merge stays blocked; if they are misattributed or inherited, they must be reclassified, which needs re-runs on the PR head and on the merge-base (MAJOR).

  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The planned file was not created. The cases live in tests/orchestrate_tracking_auto_close_cases.py (not a test_* module) and are injected into the globals of tests/test_activation_verify.py by _collect_tracking_auto_close_cases() (added lines 949-965), because ci.yml wiring is outside the file grant (tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py line 57-63). Running pytest on the planned path collects nothing, and if test_activation_verify.py is deselected, fails to import, or the shim is renamed or removed, every tracking-auto-close test silently disappears. Severity disagreement: sonnet and glm rated it NIT (a documented, deliberate deviation); gemini and minimax rated it MAJOR.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:close_completed_tracking_issue_if_ready (called at line 27432; get_issue_labels_json line 4386; handle_comprehensive_release_callback_if_needed line 27400) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the labels read fails, `[]` makes both label-absence checks pass, so the issue is closed and `.tracking_auto_close.outcome="closed"` is recorded while the release callback is left unhandled.
  WHY: Nothing retries the pending callback once the issue is closed, and `ai:integration-backpressure` stays on a closed issue. Fix: defer with `reason=labels_unavailable` unless `ai:orchestrator-tracking` is present.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:close_completed_tracking_issue_if_ready tail (post_state_comment failure paths, lines 3537-3555) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: After the PATCH, a failed state write or post_state_comment is swallowed and outcome=closed is still logged.
  WHY: A reopened issue is silently re-closed through the trusted-marker "PATCH failed earlier" branch, which breaks the reopen contract. Fix: emit a `::warning::`.
- scripts/check_triage_resolution.py:_integration_evidence | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: evidence_ref and integration_pr are set before the cross-repository and closed checks.
  WHY: Unverified results name a rejected PR in the JSON and on the CHECK_TRIAGE_RESOLVED log line. Fix: set the two fields after the trust checks.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1197-1207, 1208-1230 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The run_project_activation_verify header now sits above activation_final_verdict_from_comments.
  WHY: Documentation is attached to the wrong function; move the helper.

  Expected change site: tests/test_orchestrate_tracking_auto_close.py

  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
